category_title: Students with IDD in Task Learning Classes (SAT) focused on autonomy and adult life skills
scenario_title: Vocational skills practice and peer interaction in Task Learning Class
minimal_context: The student is preparing to practice using gardening materials in a cooperative learning group with peers from the ordinary class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are going to practice using the gardening materials. You will be doing this in a cooperative learning group with students from the ordinary class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I’m learning a lot, to use materials. Gardening, carpentry... I like all.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That is good. Please go over to their table and start working together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: In primary education I was happy with my teachers and classmates. In secondary education, it was hard at the beginning, you need to adapt.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just go join them and see what they are doing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I did not get along well with some people in the ordinary class.
